name: Rizuhble's Pinball Wraith
rows: Sell it once you're out of slots.
Get after Ricochet if needed. Ahead? Skip it until you're dying. Sell Swift Striker for it.
Silences and hexes keep stopping your teleport.
Most of their damage is spirit.
Their gun carry is out-shooting you.
Most of their damage is gun.
A big ult you can see coming, like Lash's or Infernus's.
Stuns keep cancelling your teleport and your ult.
If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
changes: Monster Rounds added first for the early-farm style (pro 89%, Strenngth's build Kieran plays starts with it) and sold when Spirit Lifesteal comes in. Tesla still lands the gun spike at 6.4k souls (gun 5.6k).

Quicksilver Reload and Mercurial Magnum moved from Full Auto to Card Trick, as in Strenngth's build: Quicksilver charges up every 18s, and Card Trick is thrown constantly while Full Auto's 45s cooldown wasted most charges. Spirit 4.8k still on Surge of Power, now at 10.4k (was 9.6k) because Monster Rounds sits in front.

Greens rebuilt right after Ricochet (16.8k): Spirit Lifesteal, Bullet Lifesteal, Sprint Boots, Enduring Speed = 4.8k health at 21.6k. Enduring Speed is core in Strenngth's build (kiting), and Bullet Lifesteal makes Leech a 3.2k upgrade instead of 4.8k. Enchanter's Emblem dropped; Battle Vest stays as the 5th green.

Berserker dropped (Wraith kites, it never stacks) for Spirit Shredder → Spirit Rend: Strenngth's core ('rend on wraith is meta'), and Tesla, Magnum, Full Auto and cards are all spirit damage so the shred and 10% spirit lifesteal apply to everything. Spirit Shredder bought mid (26.4k) so it isn't a fresh T2 late.
Core 12 slots, 48.8k (was 48k). Late is Magnum, Leech, Toxic, Capacitor, Spirit Rend, Silencer; no two fresh 6.4k items back to back.

Ability order: Mobalytics Wraith grid (Card Trick T1/T2 at 5-6, Full Auto T1 at 7, Card Trick T3 at 8, Full Auto T2/T3 at 9-11, Project Mind 11-13, Telekinesis last at 54-77%) matches Kieran's old order except that Full Auto T3 (unlimited ammo for the Ricochet/Tesla gun plan) now comes right after Card Trick T3; ult upgrades last like every public order.

Item fit: Battle Vest → Reactive Barrier. Wraith stands still to shoot (Full Auto, Telekinesis channel) and dies to stuns; Reactive Barrier is a 325 (+1.8x spirit) barrier on stun/silence. Battle Vest isn't in any public Wraith list checked (not in lockbuilds' top 30 items, tracklock core/situational, or Strenngth's build Kieran plays); Strenngth's build calls Reactive Barrier the usual survival pick. Same 1.6k green slot, health spike unchanged. Lucky Shot sell note updated.

Round 8: Frenzy note fixed. Since Jul 28 its 10% bullet lifesteal is always on (game files 6795: BulletLifestealPercent 10, plus 40% fire rate and 4m speed below 50% health). Mercurial Magnum kept on Card Trick after the Sep 16 nerf (20% +0.38): tracklock.gg Wraith pro builds, last 30 days to Oct 19 (all post-Sep 16), have it in 51% of games, Quicksilver Reload 100%, Tesla 66%.
Round 11: 'Lost lane?' box (empty): Ricochet right after Tesla Bullets, before Quicksilver Reload and Surge of Power, so you farm faster. No early tier 4 run.

Round 12: Toxic Bullets → Inhibitor (Kieran). Both cut healing, Inhibitor more (-40% vs -35%), and Inhibitor also cuts the target's damage by 30% for 5s, +150 health and +10% weapon damage. Toxic's bleed is 1.9% max health a second for 4s, only after it builds up. Wraith stands still in Full Auto, so cutting what they do back to her is the bigger gain. Same slot (37.6k, after Leech): it costs 3.2k more and moves 3.2k from gun to green. Walked: gun 4.8k @6.4k, spirit @10.4k, health @21.6k, core 52k.
Round 13: notes emptied per UPDATE 3 (only sells, swaps, slot locked, counters and verified tips kept); desc shortened to a style label (UPDATE 4).

Round 14: renamed Card Shark -> AoE Gun (style wasn't in the name); Capacitor -> Spiritual Overflow (lockbuilds Wraith 25.9% pick/58.9% WR vs Capacitor 23.8%/53.6%, tracklock core, HYPER CARRY core, Strenngth core 'wraith's best item'); Bullet Resist Shredder cut to keep 12 slots (in no current same-style list); Lucky Shot (no Wraith source) -> Boundless Spirit and Frenzy -> Spellslinger in rich (Strenngth: 'sell swift striker for this'); Extra Regen note named Battle Vest, which isn't in the build; Unstoppable note said stuns cancel Full Auto (a buff, not a channel); Dispel/Counterspell/Spirit Resilience notes fixed; duplicate sell notes removed. Walked: gun 4.8k @6.4k, spirit @10.4k, health @21.6k, core 53.6k.

Round 15: Counters caption was 119 chars (game limit 112, no shorter pair fits with Reactive Barrier): now 'Get after Ricochet ... Sell Swift Striker for it.' (110) and Spellslinger sells Reactive Barrier instead, so each item is sold once; Divine Barrier added to the rich box with 'If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.' (Dispel Magic is in Counters; Kieran's layout rule).
Round 20: Tesla Bullets now upgrades to Capacitor and Reactive Barrier to Indomitable in the late list (Reactive Barrier was being sold); core+late 74.4k.

Round 23: Escalating Exposure in at #2 of the late list (sells Spirit Rend, whose spirit-resist cut it replaces), Boundless Spirit out. Wraith's spirit damage is many small hits (cards 85 + 0.95x every 0.6s, Tesla chains, Mercurial and Full Auto spirit bullets), so a stacking +54% spirit amp beats +30 spirit. Spellslinger now sells Enduring Speed, since Counters already sell Swift Striker.
Round 25: ability order 1132134332122444 -> 1132341322314424 (worked out from the kit for this build's playstyle).
Cost pass: removed the Lost lane reorder box (put a lone 6.4k buy at 12.8k and delayed the spirit 4.8k); renamed.
